subtasks.task_text: Explain the requirements for livestock identification and transportation.
subtasks.text: Mention that before purchasing any stock, a property identification code (PIC) is necessary.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the requirements for livestock identification and transportation.
subtasks.text: Describe that South Wales properties carrying livestock must have a PIC, regardless of the number of animals.

subtasks.task_text: Detail the process of identifying stock for transportation and recording movements.
subtasks.text: Note that stock must be correctly identified with the National Livestock Identification System (NLIS).

subtasks.task_text: Detail the process of identifying stock for transportation and recording movements.
subtasks.text: Explain that all movements of stock must be recorded on the NLIS database.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the importance of notifying local land services about suspected livestock diseases.
subtasks.text: Highlight that livestock owners must notify local land services if they suspect or are aware of livestock diseases.

subtasks.task_text: Emphasize the importance of understanding pasture management and feeding programs during drought.
subtasks.text: Mention that livestock owners should have a solid understanding of pasture management and feeding programs during drought.
